entry.title: Exploring a material that changes shape
entry.summary: The authors describe pressing and squeezing pliable materials in their 9–12-month section. For play dough, they describe stopping and trying later if the baby keeps eating it.
entry.cue: Your baby is using thumb and fingers to squeeze, press, or pull.
detail: Their examples include play dough, tissue paper to tear, and squeezable bath toys, within their broader requirement for suitable materials and secure components.
For dough, the authors describe showing a press on the table or a squeeze in the fist. If eating continues, they put the activity aside and try again after a few weeks.
